integrity: Exact analytic proof plus standalone exact-rational finite consistency checks; no independent scientific audit or historical priority certification. The closest 1993 Berg primary paper was not inspected in full.
limitations: The claim applies to the beta-binomial stationary law of fully mixed interacting free voters, positive \(\alpha>\beta>0\), and strict majorities (ties do not count as correct). A general closed-form threshold index is not asserted.
title: A strict-majority parity law and a sharp even-electorate crossover under beta-binomial social influence
